question.text: In a bull call spread, if USDINR at expiry is exactly at the lower strike, the result is:

answer.text: Maximum loss (both options expire worthless, trader loses net premium paid)

explanation.text: The Logic: At or below the lower strike (83), both calls are OTM, both expire worthless, and the trader loses the Rs. 0.06 net premium — this is the maximum loss for the spread. The Trap: Above the lower strike but below BEP (83.06): partial recovery of premium but still a loss. Note: Max loss region: at or below the lower strike. Max profit region: at or above the higher strike. Between: partial P&L, with BEP at 83.06. Source: NISM-Series-I Currency Derivatives workbook, pp.102-103.
